proposed_widenings.name: GrantResistanceOperation
proposed_widenings.justification: OngoingOperation currently supports only roll_modifier and damage_on_hit. Protection from Energy grants Resistance to a damage type — halving all incoming damage of that type on the target. This concept has no representation in the current operation vocabulary. The v4 taxonomy already includes grant_resistance as a named atom (TAXONOMY_atoms_graph.md line 198), so no new atom is needed — only a new variant of OngoingOperation and a corresponding branch in traceOngoingOperation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: the willing creature you touch has Resistance to one damage type of your choice: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder

notes: All structural fields fit cleanly: family=ongoing_effect, castingTime=action, range=touch, components={v,s}, duration=concentration up to 1 hour, attachment=target(one). The DamageType atom covers all five damage types listed. The caster chooses one damage type at cast time; the encoded form stores the chosen DamageType in the operation. The only gap is the missing OngoingOperation variant. Proposed shape: { kind: 'grant_resistance'; damageType: DamageType }. The tracer would need a grant_resistance case in traceOngoingOperation emitting a grant_resistance atom node with a grants edge from procId and an attaches_to edge to attId.
